<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import os

# Read input
input_path = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Replace empty strings with NaN for proper missing value detection
df = df.replace('', pd.NA)

# Identify indicator columns (exclude meta columns)
meta_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
indicator_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in meta_cols]

# Compute missingness per indicator
total_rows = len(df)
report_rows = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = int(df[col].isna().sum())
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_rows if total_rows > 0 else 0.0
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    report_rows.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': missing_count,
        'missing_rate': missing_rate,
        'kept': kept
    })

# Write missingness report
report_df = pd.DataFrame(report_rows)
os.makedirs('outputs', exist_ok=True)
report_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False, quoting=1)

# Write selected matrix (city_id, city_name, year + kept indicators)
kept_cols = [r['indicator'] for r in report_rows if r['kept']]
selected_cols = meta_cols + kept_cols
df[selected_cols].to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False, quoting=1)
</solution_file>
